[LGRA.21.3] **Construction and matching reuse the DS surface.** A constructed fact
(`test_fact`, `reply_fact`) reuses the emit-style `action_arg` colon-kwargs
([LGRA.10]); a matched head reuses subset kwargs or — on `emitted`, in
their place — the rule `where_clause` predicate ([LTSL.4.2], [LTSL.8.4]). No second fact syntax
is introduced. The eleven `test_head` alternatives map one-to-one to the surface
assertion heads and their `Oracle*` atoms ([LTSL.8.2]).
